geography: Worldwide (Y-mAbs net product revenue; DANYELZA is its only product)

launch_evidence.quote: The Company launched DANYELZA in February 2021 and recorded $5.4 million in net revenues for the three months ended March 31, 2021.

series_end_reason: Y-mAbs was acquired by SERB Pharmaceuticals through a tender offer: its 8-K of 2025-09-16 (items 2.01, 3.01, 5.01) reports completion of the merger, Form 25-NSE was filed 2025-09-16 and Form 15-12G on 2025-09-26 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1722964/000110465925093587/tm2525998d10_1512g.htm). Its last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 (filed 2025-08-08); no 2025Q3 report exists.
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1722964 (Y-mAbs Therapeutics) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched the exhibits of every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2020-11 to 2025-12.

Rows read from the 'Product revenue, net' / 'Net product revenue' line of the condensed consolidated statements of operations in each quarterly earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, thousands). The FY2021 Form 10-K prints 2020 product revenue as a dash, so 2021Q1 is the first quarter of sales. 2021Q4 is derived (the 2021Q4 release prints only full-year columns). The quarter of each release is confirmed by the prior-year comparative column.
Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 14 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing.
